headline.caveat: ~3.5GW of Google-designed, Broadcom-supplied TPU capacity coming online from 2027; dollar value undisclosed — Mizuho estimates Broadcom AI revenue from Anthropic of ~$21B in 2026 and ~$42B in 2027

realized_to_date.caveat: capacity from 2027; nothing recognized yet from this expansion

nature_md: Three-way deal announced Apr 6, 2026: Anthropic secures approximately **3.5GW of TPU compute capacity from 2027**, with Broadcom designing and supplying the Google-architecture TPUs (Broadcom simultaneously committed to develop Google's TPU generations through 2031). This is *additional* to the ~1GW coming online in 2026 under the Oct 2025 Google Cloud agreement. Notably conditioned: filings state Anthropic's use of the expanded capacity is **contingent on its continued commercial performance** — a rare disclosed gate tying compute expansion to revenue delivery (run-rate had passed $30B at announcement, up from $9B at end-2025). Structure (who books what between Google and Broadcom) is not fully public; Broadcom ships the silicon/systems, hence this edge.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Forward capacity commitment with a disclosed performance contingency — Anthropic keeps an exit if growth stalls, making this softer than take-or-pay. Spend will blend hardware-linked payments (Broadcom side) and cloud consumption (Google side); the split is undisclosed.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: For Broadcom: custom-accelerator (XPU) revenue on shipment from 2027, stacking Anthropic onto Google, Meta, and OpenAI as concentrated AI customers (Mizuho: $21B/2026 → $42B/2027 from Anthropic alone — estimates, not guidance).

events.title: Anthropic, Google, Broadcom announce ~3.5GW TPU expansion from 2027
